Origin Talent PointYour Origin Constellation only (Ancestry, Bloodline, Culture)If obtained after character creation, unless otherwise stated
Calling Talent PointCalling Constellations onlyIf obtained after character creation, unless otherwise stated

CometAnything you qualify forNo
Milestone Talent PointAnything you qualify forYes. If no Constellation is Flared, it becomes a Deferred Talent Point
Deferred Talent PointAnything you qualify forYes; must be spent the instant a Constellation is Flared

StepYou chooseYou getTalent Points
1. AncestryYour body and blood. This forms the core of your Origin Constellation and gives you starting Hit Points, Speed, and unique characteristics.Hit Points per level, Size, Speed, and 1 Special Ability.1 Origin (your Ancestry's root Talent)
2. BloodlineYour lineage. This adds a branch to your Origin Constellation and gives you additional unique characteristics.1 Special Ability.1 Origin (your Bloodline's root Talent)
3. CultureWhere you were raised. This adds a branch to your Origin Constellation.Starting language(s), and a bonus to Diplomacy checks with those who share your Culture.1 Origin (your Culture's Root Talent)
4. BackgroundYour trade. This grants 1 Lore Talent Point and 2 Skill Talent Points.—1 Lore / 2 Skill
5. CallingYour adventuring identity. This adds special techniques such as entering a rage or sneak attacking.Training in one Skill or other Constellation.1 Calling
6. DefensesYour defensive posture (Awareness, Evade, Guard, and Endure).—1 Defense
7. CometsComets, which are Talent Points that can be used for any purpose (as long as you still meet the prerequisite).—3 Comets

ZoneCritical HitCritical Hit on an Exposed Zone
HeadThe target cannot use reactions until it Recenters.As left, and the target's Wounded value increases by 3.
TorsoThe target is Off-Guard until it Recenters.As left, and the target's Wounded value increases by 2.
ArmsThe target takes a −2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls until it Recenters.As left, and the target's Wounded value increases by 1.
LegsThe target's Speed is halved until it Recenters.As left, and the target's Wounded value increases by 1.

StepDo this
1Apply Immunity.
2Add up all remaining dice, damage bonuses, and damage modifiers.
3Add Weakness of the applicable damage type(s).
4Subtract Resistance from the dice rolls of the applicable damage type(s).
5Double the total if it was a Critical Hit.
6Subtract Protection from the total (if applicable).
7Deal damage to Temporary Hit Points (if applicable).
8Deal damage to Hit Points.

StepDo this
1If the Zone is Exposed, its Protection is 0; you can stop here.
2Start with the Protection of the piece worn there. No piece worn means 0.
3Add any bonus that applies to that Zone (a matched harness adds 1 to your Torso; some Talents add to every Zone).
4Subtract 1 if the incoming damage type is the one that piece's material turns poorly. A Zone with no armor has no material, and so has no such weakness.
5Subtract any Protection the attacker ignores.

ConditionEffect
Off-Guard−2 circumstance to Evade and Guard against all foes.
Wrong-Footed [X]Off-Guard against that creature only.
Frightened N−N to all checks and Thresholds; reduce by 1 at end of each of your turns.
ProneOff-Guard, −2 to Attacks; +2 circumstance to Evade vs. ranged Attacks. Stand ◆ to clear.
GrabbedOff-Guard and can't Move or Step; Escape ◆ to break free.
HeedlessCommitment so complete that you have stopped thinking. Actions and Activities with Concentrate take 1 extra action.
RestrainedAs Grabbed but can't take any action other than Escape ◆.
Stunned NLose the next N actions; may carry over across turns.
Slowed NLose N actions at the start of each of your turns. Reduce by 1 at end of each of your turns.
Fatigued−1 to Evade and Guard; can't use Exploration Mode Activities.
Persistent DamageTake it at end of each turn; Endure check (10 + the level of the effect + the amount you just took) to end.
Dying / WoundedYou're Dying and unconscious. Recovery checks at the start of each of your turns.
Exposed [Zone]That Zone's Protection counts as 0 and ordinary Hits can land there instead of your Torso. Recenter ◆ to clear.
BlindedCannot see. Cannot Observe any creature. Is Off-Guard.
DeafenedCannot hear. Immune to any Auditory Action or Activity.
UnconsciousYou have 0 Hit Points, you drop everything you are holding, and you are also Prone.

TraitEffect
AgileYour multiple attack penalty with it is −4 and −8 rather than −5 and −10.
Armor-Piercing [N]Ignore N Protection when dealing piercing damage with this weapon.
Capacity [N]The weapon can fire N times before it must be reloaded. Reloading its full capacity takes the listed Reload actions.
CloseYou may attack with it while you are Grabbed, while Squeezing, and against a creature you have Grabbed, with no penalty.
Deadly dXOn a critical hit, add one die of the listed size to the damage.
FinesseYou may use Agility instead of Might on attack rolls with this weapon. Damage still uses Might.
Grapple, Trip, Disarm, ShoveYou may attempt that maneuver with this weapon in hand rather than a free hand.
MechanicalYou do not add Might to damage with this weapon.
NonlethalIt knocks out rather than kills.
ParrySpend ◆ to gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Guard for physical Attacks until the start of your next turn.
Ranged [N]You may Strike a target up to N feet away. Use Agility instead of Might for the Attack roll.
Reload [N]It takes N actions to reload before it can be fired again.
Sweep+1 circumstance bonus to attack a target you have not yet attacked this turn.
Thrown XYou may throw it up to X feet, using Might for the attack roll.
Two-Hand dXWielded in two hands, its damage die becomes dX.
Two-HandedIt requires both hands.
Unwieldy [N]You take a −2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls with it against a target within N feet, and you cannot attack with it at all while you are Grabbed.
Versatile XYou may deal X damage instead of its usual type.

TraitEffect
ComfortYou can sleep in it without waking fatigued.
Noisy−1 circumstance penalty to Stealth, on top of your Load Strain.
QuietYour Load Strain never applies to Stealth while this is your only armor.

TraitEffect
AttackCounts toward your multiple attack penalty, and suffers it. Your first attack in a turn is unpenalized, your second takes −5, and your third and beyond take −10.
MoveYou change position under your own power. Moving out of a foe's reach may provoke a reaction from anyone who has a Talent that allows it.
ManipulateYou use your hands. You need at least one free, and fine work near an enemy can provoke a reaction from them.
ConcentrateActions and Activities with this Trait take an extra action to complete if you are Heedless.
StanceA way of standing and holding yourself. You can be in only one stance at a time, and it lasts until you leave it, fall unconscious, or enter another.
PressYou may use it only while you are already suffering a multiple attack penalty, and never on someone else's turn. Some press actions add an effect on a failure; that effect never applies on a critical failure.
AuditoryIt works through sound. It fails on the deafened, and on anyone who cannot hear you.
VisualIt works through sight. It fails on the blinded, and on anyone who cannot see you.
MentalIt works on the mind. It fails on anything mindless.
EmotionA mental effect that works on feeling. Anything immune to emotion ignores it.
ReactionNot a Trait so much as a cost: it happens on someone else's turn, and you have one per round.

HandlingMeaningIf you lack Familiarity
IntuitiveGeneral weapon training transfers easilyUse your full Weapons Proficiency Bonus
PracticedRequires familiarity with that weapon familyUse your Weapons Proficiency Bonus one rank lower
TechnicalRequires specialized instructionYou are Untrained

StateWhat your foe knowsEffectExamples
ObservedExactly what squares you are in, and precisely where you are positioned.—Your foe can plainly see all of you.
ConcealedExactly what squares you are in, but something prevents them seeing all of you.+2 circumstance bonus to Evade and Guard for physical Attacks.Mist, dim light, foliage.
HiddenThat you are present, but not what squares you occupy.They must guess one of your squares to attack you, and you gain +4 to Evade and Guard for physical Attacks. Your foe is Wrong-Footed to you.Your foe is blind, or you succeeded on a Sneak.
UndetectedNo idea you are even present.You cannot be targeted at all. Your foe is Wrong-Footed to you.Your foe cannot see, hear, smell, or feel you.

If a creature is inEffect on you
Bright lightNothing. You see them normally.
Dim lightThey are Concealed to you.
DarknessThey are Hidden to you, or Undetected if you did not already know something was there.

Zones coveredGradeEffect
1Lesser Cover+1 circumstance bonus to your Evade and Guard for physical Attacks.
2Cover+2 circumstance bonus to your Evade and Guard for physical Attacks.
3Greater Cover+4 circumstance bonus to your Evade and Guard for physical Attacks.
4Total CoverYou cannot be targeted at all for physical Attacks.

ResultEffect
Critical successYour Dying ends. You are conscious, on your feet if you spend an action to stand, with 1 Hit Point.
SuccessYour Dying value drops by 1. If it reaches 0, your Dying ends and you are stable: still unconscious, but no longer sliding.
FailureYour Dying value rises by 1.
Critical failureYour Dying value rises by 2.

LanguageRarityNotes
CommonCommonThe trade tongue of the roads, ports, and mercenary camps: everyone's second language and nobody's first.
SerrovineUncommonThe tongue of Serrovane: precise, clause-ridden, and built for oaths that will be read back to you later.
ReachspeakUncommonThe dock-cant of the Kestrel Reach: fast, borrowed from six directions, and rich in words for a bad deal.
